structural_change_from_v6.observed_failure: v6-week-1 was positive but sparse: five trades, three wins, +2.62% for the week and +0.37% daily geometric growth. The stress inventory scenario generated no trades.
structural_change_from_v6.cause: v6 required raw OI creation AND an extreme executed-notional burst. That conflated two independent inventory-transfer mechanisms and discarded valid deleveraging continuation, particularly shorts confirmed by OI contraction.
structural_change_from_v6.v7_resolution: After the unchanged base displacement state, stress continuation is confirmed when either side-adjusted OI change strictly exceeds its shifted past-only 95th percentile OR the executed-notional burst strictly exceeds its shifted past-only 95th percentile. Long OI transfer is OI creation; short OI transfer is OI contraction. Equality never counts as a shock.
structural_change_from_v6.unchanged: basis regime, sweep competing risk, all price/flow/absorption/efficiency conditions, next-minute execution, costs, 3% NAV risk sizing, one-position constraint, targets, invalidation and funding remain unchanged.

normal_basis: confirmed swing liquidity failure and resumption
negative_basis_stress: rejected sweep becomes a target-versus-extreme competing-risk probe; extreme first confirms continuation
or a completed base displacement is confirmed by directional OI transfer or extreme executed-notional shock
causal_sequence.observation: all rolling percentiles are shifted by one minute; current shock cannot enter its own reference distribution
causal_sequence.execution: entry at the following one-minute open after every required observation

execution_and_risk.quantity_denominator: adverse entry-to-stop fill distance plus entry fee, stop fee, slippage and planned adverse funding
execution_and_risk.global_constraint: at most one entry intent or one open position

inventory_quantile.0.975: all remain profitable and above 1% daily geometric growth, but the former v6-week-1 becomes too sparse for the active-day gate
inventory_quantile.0.90: too permissive; the 2024-08 stress week falls below 1% daily geometric growth

quantile_window_minutes.480: the former v6-week-1 is positive but narrowly below 1% daily geometric growth

known_failure_conditions: Lowering the inventory shock quantile to 0.90 admits too many ordinary displacement bars and weakens the stress-week expectancy.
A 480-minute reference distribution reacts too quickly to a local burst cluster and slightly underproduces growth in one development week.
The candidate has not yet passed any untouched v7 week; development success is not promotion evidence.
